traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and named requirements for Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports annotations on test files are enforced with clear error messages and an optional safe auto-fix template. - describe() (and related) calls are validated to contain a story reference based on a configurable regex pattern. - it()/test() names must begin with a [REQ-XXX] requirement prefix, with safe normalization for malformed but recognizable prefixes and no guessing of new IDs. - Test file detection is implemented via configurable path-substring patterns and tested to distinguish test from non-test files. - The rule supports Jest and Mocha-style APIs (describe/it/test/context, including member forms like describe.each) and handles nested describe blocks by enforcing the rule on all describe calls. - The rule is integrated into the plugin’s exports and both recommended and strict presets, and is documented in both README and API reference. - Dedicated unit tests for this rule, tied via @supports to this story, pass in the full Jest test run. Given this concrete evidence, the story is fully implemented and passing.
